verdict.rationale: Latham's own IP Litigation pages document a team of more than 100 IP litigators handling patent, trademark, copyright and trade-secret cases. Trade secrets is a listed focus area. The courts, venues and outcomes part of the story is met only by a generic claim of a "winning track record across US and global venues", with no named courts or case results. The trademark page mostly describes prosecution and contracts rather than litigation. Missing for 10: specific named courts or venues (e.g., district courts, ITC, PTAB), concrete case outcomes or verdicts, trademark litigation-specific detail, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: Our team of more than 100 IP litigators brings trial-tested experience to matters ranging from cutting-edge pharmaceutical and technology patent disputes to the copyright, trademark, and trade secrets cases that reshape industries.
Latham brings vast trial experience, technical prowess, and a winning track record across US and global venues to the most complex and mission-critical patent disputes.
Skilled in handling an array of IP matters, notably patent infringement, trademark infringement, trade secret and breach of contract disputes
